title: SAG: SQL-Retrieval Augmented Generation with Query-Time Dynamic Hyperedges
abstract: arXiv:2606.15971v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: While retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) has proven effective at giving LLMs access to external knowledge, mainstream dense-retrieval implementations remain inherently limited in handling structured constraints and multi-hop reasoning. Graph-based methods address this by constructing knowledge graphs offline, but they often fragment semantics, incur high maintenance, and complicate incremental updates. We propose SAG (SQL-Retrieval Augmented Generation), a structured retrieval architecture that organizes documents into an event-entity index without building a global knowledge graph. SAG represents each chunk as a semantically complete event paired with its entities, forming a latent hyperedge that preserves n-ary relations without decomposing them into triples. translated_title: SAG：查询时动态超边的SQL检索增强生成
translated_abstract: arXiv:2606.15971v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：虽然检索增强生成（RAG）已被证明能有效为大型语言模型提供外部知识，但主流密集检索实现本质上在处理结构化约束和多跳推理方面仍存在局限性。基于图的方法通过离线构建知识图谱来解决这一问题，但它们常常割裂语义、维护成本高，且使增量更新复杂化。我们提出SAG（SQL检索增强生成），一种结构化检索架构，它将文档组织成事件-实体索引，而无需构建全局知识图谱。SAG将每个文本块表示为一个语义完整的事件及其相关实体，形成一个潜在超边，保留n元关系而不将其分解为三元组。在查询时，SAG将共享实体视为连接键以关联相关文本块，动态生成查询范围内的相关事件邻域，而所有证据片段保持完整。
tldr: SAG提出一种基于SQL的检索增强生成架构，通过事件-实体索引和查询时动态超边，在不构建全局知识图谱的情况下实现结构化约束和多跳推理，同时保留完整语义证据。
en_tdlr: SAG proposes a SQL-based retrieval-augmented generation architecture that leverages event-entity indexing and query-time dynamic hyperedges to handle structured constraints and multi-hop reasoning without building a global knowledge graph, while preserving complete semantic evidence.
